svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Roof drainage, PV / SWH, lighting & ceiling layout
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
Roof: 0.53 mm IBR (AZ150, Chromadek Charcoal) fixed with 6.3 mm self-drilling screws + EPDM washers, every rib at eaves/ridge, alternate ribs elsewhere.
Gutters: 125 mm square Zincalume, falls 1:500 to 75 mm Ø downpipes (6 No.) discharging to concrete channels / rainwater tank option.
PV: 40 × 550 W mono modules (22 kWp) on rails; hybrid inverter + 30 kWh LiFePO4 battery in DB room (by M&E). SWH: 4 × 300 L close-coupled, feeding male showers.
Lightning protection: 8 mm Al ridge conductor with air terminals, 2 down conductors to Type B ring earth (BS EN 62305, Class III — confirm by risk assessment).
L2 1 200 mm LED vapour-proof batten 36 W, IP65 (150–200 lx)
L3 LED bulkhead 12 W, IP65 (verandah, photocell)
Ceiling fan 1 400 mm Ø with regulator
Extract fan 150 mm, ducted to gable louvre
Maintained LED exit sign / emergency (3 h)
C1 6.4 mm gypsum board, skim + PVA
Lux targets per architect constitution §15.1 / CIBSE SLL; emergency lighting BS 5266 (3 h); detection BS 5839-1 L3. Final circuits by M&E
